say:1:1711148001:1.text: What's wrong, Kirsty? I had already packed my things and was ready to leave work on time...
say:1:1711148001:1.source_cn: 怎么了，科丝蒂？我刚才都已经收拾好东西准备准点下班了……

say:2:1711148002:1.text: Even if the sky falls, shouldn't I be the one to hold it up tomorrow?
say:2:1711148002:1.source_cn: 就算天塌下来，也该让明天的我去顶吧？

say:3:1711148003:1.text: Weren't you here for afternoon tea? I brought pumpkin tarts...
say:3:1711148003:1.source_cn: 不是来吃下午茶的吗？我带了南瓜馅饼……

say:10:1711148008:1.text: Wait a minute! You don't suspect that the two of us did it, do you?!
say:10:1711148008:1.source_cn: 等一下！你们该不会怀疑是我们俩干的吧？！

choice_prompt:11:1711148008.text: Wait a minute! You don't suspect that the two of us did it, do you?!
choice_prompt:11:1711148008.source_cn: 等一下！你们该不会怀疑是我们俩干的吧？！

say:12:1711148009:0.text: Lately, we've been working non-stop from the moment we open our eyes, how could we have time to take this away!
say:12:1711148009:0.source_cn: 最近这段时间，我们两眼一睁就是工作，怎么有时间拿走这个！

say:16:1711148012:1.text: But... what is the purpose of us obtaining this report?
say:16:1711148012:1.source_cn: 可是……我们拿报告的目的是什么呀？

say:19:1711148015:1.text: The report is indeed missing. If it disappeared after being archived, then who...?
say:19:1711148015:1.source_cn: 可报告确实不见了。如果在归档后就不在了，那究竟是谁……

choice_prompt:20:1711148015.text: The report is indeed missing. If it disappeared after being archived, then who...?
choice_prompt:20:1711148015.source_cn: 可报告确实不见了。如果在归档后就不在了，那究竟是谁……

choice_prompt:22:1711148016.text: We cannot rule out the possibility that if he tampered with the documents before they were filed, we would indeed have no way of knowing.
choice_prompt:22:1711148016.source_cn: 不排除这个可能性，如果他在归档之前就动了手脚，我们也确实无法得知。

say:23:1711148017:1.text: It's unlikely. After his accident, the property he lived in was quickly sold by his relatives.
say:23:1711148017:1.source_cn: 不太可能。他出事后，所住的房产很快就被他的亲戚给出售了。

say:24:1711148018:1.text: We attended the funeral, and apart from the coffin already being sealed, there didn't seem to be anything special about it.
say:24:1711148018:1.source_cn: 我们去参加了葬礼，除了已经封棺外，好像也没有什么特别之处。

choice_prompt:25:1711148018.text: We attended the funeral, and apart from the coffin already being sealed, there didn't seem to be anything special about it.
choice_prompt:25:1711148018.source_cn: 我们去参加了葬礼，除了已经封棺外，好像也没有什么特别之处。

say:26:1711148019:1.text: As for anything unusual... apart from the wind being a bit strong in the cemetery, nothing else seems to be wrong.
say:26:1711148019:1.source_cn: 异常嘛……除了墓园的风有点大，好像没别的事。

say:27:1711148020:1.text: Ah, the only thing I remember is that Kraft's tombstone was really elaborate.
say:27:1711148020:1.source_cn: 啊，我唯一有印象的是，克拉夫特的墓碑真的很考究。

say:31:1711148024:1.text: No, Kraft died in an experimental accident!
say:31:1711148024:1.source_cn: 不对，克拉夫特是死于实验意外！

choice_prompt:34:1711148026.text: Oh right! I haven't heard anything about Kraft's achievements in astrology and divination, so how did he figure this out!
choice_prompt:34:1711148026.source_cn: 对哦！也没挺说克拉夫特在占星和占卜上有什么成就，他怎么算得出这个！

say:35:1711148027:1.text: Clearly, Mr. Kraft's "death" was a pre-arranged farewell.
say:35:1711148027:1.source_cn: 很显然，那位克拉夫特先生的“死亡”，是自己提前安排好的谢幕。

choice:34:0:1.source_cn: 这是一场蓄谋已久的骗局

choice:25:0:1.text: Thinking about it carefully, is there really nothing unusual?
choice:25:0:1.source_cn: 仔细想想，真的没什么异常吗？

choice:22:0:1.source_cn: 仔细想想克拉夫特生前的事

choice:22:1:2.text: Is it possible that the report is still at his house?
choice:22:1:2.source_cn: 报告有没有可能还在他家里

choice:20:0:1.text: Perhaps it disappeared before it was even archived.
choice:20:0:1.source_cn: 或许，在归档前就不见了

choice:11:0:1.text: You have a chance to take it while things are in chaos
choice:11:0:1.source_cn: 你们有机会趁乱拿走它

choice:11:1:2.text: Perhaps it was you who stole the classified report?
choice:11:1:2.source_cn: 或许，就是你们偷拿了机密报告？
